summary: Accept runtime workspace observations before the activity projection rollout

replay.detail: Reader compatibility only: no producer emits workspace and no historical attribution is inferred.

schema.detail: Accept optional nullable runtime.observed.workspace and advertise runtime_workspace=1 reader support. No new persisted state, storage-version or client-v0 changes.

rules.detail: Retain the pure per-incarnation activity row and envelope contract. No activity daemon route, CLI command, request-time history reducer or query is shipped. Existing agents ls is unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Unsupported readers retain unknown fields and kinds unprojected, suppress projection digests and refuse individual unknown signed claims. Phase 2 in fractal#7013 requires both signed runtime_workspace capability support and a rollback target at or after phase 1. Rollback below phase 1 after emission is unsupported.

manual.detail: No new operator read surface in this phase. Phase 2 adds activity reads from a maintained incarnation/workspace projection, not request-time replay of retained history.

recovery.detail: Phase 2 must resolve the physical workspace before launch, launch in exactly that directory and publish the same path; never canonicalize an authored alias after launch.
